Hello, this hasn't had an update in quite a while so thought of sharing something you might find interesting! We're currently in Closed Beta for Persistence, which comes with the new ability to have persistent inventory items for worlds! More specifically, this can be done via what we're currently calling Player Objects.

Highly recommend to watch [Karet's demo in one of our recent Dev Updates](https://ask.vrchat.com/t/developer-update-19-september-2024/26829#p-56092-persistent-user-data-open-beta-coming-soon-5), its a pretty cool example of this in action for an inventory of neat trading cards. In their words: `The system uses both Player Data, to record what cards you have, and Player Objects, to spawn them into the world via my inventory system.`

You can find more about our plans and current documentation on Persistence there, but in short it should be coming to open beta quite soon 👀. Also here's the main Persistence canny post if you want to follow along: https://feedback.vrchat.com/udon/p/save-load-persistent-world-data. For now will keep this post separate but let me know if you'd rather have this merged into that one.
@{628d00a6b624bb0b622328ef|full_name} Given persistence is now released and supports what OP is asking, this suggestion should probably be closed, right?

details:
In addition to the inventory post that already exist, I want to be able to give players items to consume/spawn only usable in my world.
For example, if I make a Minecraft-esque world every player would find a starter kit in their inventory with a shovel, axe, torch and pickaxe. When leaving the world the items would disappear. Or a flare gun players can use to find each other on super large worlds.
Assuming persistence exists, a tick box would exist on the imaginary item component to either make it disappear on switching world or you keep it forever (Or until consumed?)
